sql:
WITH order_lines_cte AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty as order_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_id, qty) as rn
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT 
        i.product_id,
        i.location_id,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        i.purchase_id,
        i.qty,
        p.purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines_cte)
    AND l.warehouse = 1
),
order_total AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(order_qty) as total_order_qty
    FROM order_lines_cte
    GROUP BY product_id
),
picking AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.product_id,
        inv.location_id,
        inv.aisle,
        inv.position,
        inv.qty as avail_qty,
        inv.rn,
        ot.total_order_qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(ot.total_order_qty - SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), ot.total_order_qty) > 0 
            THEN LEAST(inv.qty, COALESCE(ot.total_order_qty - SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), ot.total_order_qty))
            ELSE 0 
        END as pick_qty
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_total ot ON inv.product_id = ot.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, pick_qty 
FROM picking 
WHERE pick_qty > 0 
ORDER BY product_id, rn
